target_customer: People with diabetes who test blood glucose and want cheaper strips read by a smartphone camera instead of a meter
problem: Blood glucose test strips and meters are costly; the company aimed to read low-cost strips with a phone camera.
business_model: Consumable test strips plus app (a directory lists a $29 per month plan, unverified)

founders.name: Sam Kanawati
founders.background_notes: Only founder named on the YC page. Directory snippets name Salil Pathare as co-founder and CTO, but I did not open a company or Crunchbase page, so he is not listed here.

competitors.name: AkibaH (GluCase)
competitors.what: Smartphone case with built-in glucose meter, strips and lancets
competitors.traction_then: crowdfunded on Indiegogo; production and clinical studies planned

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate glucose readout from a camera image under varying light, plus strip chemistry manufacturing and likely FDA clearance, is hard for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Regulatory clearance could be a barrier if achieved, but no clearance or patent is found, and incumbents own strip distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it; incumbents were launching smaller meters (an iHealth launch appears in results, undated).

market_need_then: Test strip cost is a recurring burden for people with diabetes, and phone-based glucose tools such as GluCase and academic strips were being explored, but I found no direct demand data for this company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, low-cost positioning in the YC tagline.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no press, logo or community material about this company.

outcome_analysis: Simple Strips was a two-person Winter 2020 health diagnostics company pitching low-cost glucose strips read by a phone camera. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but no shutdown post, news or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. The product needed accurate image reading, strip manufacturing and probably regulatory clearance against entrenched strip makers, but no source states which obstacle ended it.
notes: simplestrips.com returned HTTP 503 so the site could not be read. The $200K round rests on a single aggregator (FundedIQ, which names no investors and no original source); the stage label is not stated. Crunchbase listing (simple-stripes) was not readable. A GlucoScreen paper from the University of Washington is a 2023 academic project, unrelated and not listed. Founders: Salil Pathare reported as co-founder and CTO by a search snippet only.
